answer: A split-tally bond stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks 60 credits for a tally at a knoll registry: half sealed in a relic it keeps, half held by the registrar, both joined in a vine log. Each epoch an eighth shows its relic half; mismatch burns the bond. Cutting costs 45, so one fake costs 105; 1,000 fakes cost 105,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 65,000 loss. Rented halves fail: halves are key-bound. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep the bond.
